text: Easy. I love my fairy lights on a timer!  My house is so festive with no fuss

product_metadata.title: Kangheshun Timer Led String Lights,1 Pack Battery Powered Starry Fairy Mini Light,Battery Operated Micro Lights for Bedroom,Christmas,Parties,Wedding,Centerpiece,Decoration (5m/16ft Warm White)
features: Warm white micro leds are super bright, creating warm atmosphere. The led bulbs create a 360° sparkling glowing. The effect is much better than incandescent lights
The bulbs are built on ultra slim thin silver wire. 4'' Distance Between LED Bulbs. Battery case dimension: 2" x 2-3/4" x 3/4". Operated by 3 AA Batteries (Not Included)

Timer/Steady On/off: The switch has three positions, off to the left, on to the right. Push the switch to the middle you can active the timer function for 6 hours on and 18th hours off. Batteries last around 48 Hours when you use them 24/7 without stopping.
These string lights are excellent decoration for Christmas, holiday, celebrations, weddings, Halloween, Christmas, Valentine's, Mardi Gras, custom parties, creating fairy effects
The light string is waterproof, but the battery case is not waterproof. If you order these lights for outdoor use, please wrapping the battery compartments up in plastic bags or waterproof box
